training.title: TRAINING
training.note: Changes count at once, the opponent's fielders and a goalie coming back from the next kickoff.
training.item_about: What your team holds at every kickoff, and keeps when it uses it.
training.quantity_about: How many of it your team gets; a single one is thrown giant.
training.fielders_about: How many of the opponent's four fielders play; the captain is the last to go.
training.skip_goals_about: A goal goes straight to the kickoff.

quit.title: QUIT
quit.note_match: Quit Recharged? The game closes, and the match is not finished.

gameplay.title: GAMEPLAY
gameplay.in_match: A match is on: it keeps the options it started with.

menus.name: Menus
menus.about: Changes take effect at once; Skip intro from the next start.

matches.name: Matches
matches.about: Changes take effect from the next match (the Super Team is in the launcher).

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.about: Rules for fairer matches, from the next match.

display.camera_online: The match camera can be changed outside online matches.
display.camera_about: DYNAMIC zooms with the play, STATIC keeps the zoom level below.
display.zoom_level_about: How far the camera stays from the play (1 is nearest).
display.picture_about: {{shape}} keeps the game's shape, Stretch fills the window.
display.picture_about_wider: {{shape}} keeps the game's shape, Stretch fills the window, Wider view shows more of the field.
display.resolution_about: Full draws the 3D at {{full}}, Native at the Wii's {{native}}.
display.performance_numbers_about: Shows the frame rate and the computer's load in a corner of the picture.
display.style_about: MODERN is crisp; TV adds the Wii's flicker filter and a TV's softness.
display.tv_border_about: The empty border a Wii sends around its picture, which a TV hides.
display.upscaling_about: How a lower 3D resolution fills the window. SHARP keeps pixels square.
display.performance_mode_about: No crowd, ambient effects or bloom, from the next match. Gameplay is unchanged.
display.vsync_about: Shows each frame in step with the display, without tearing.
display.frame_rate_about: More frames for smoother motion; the game keeps its own speed.
display.background_about: The most frames per second while another window has the focus, to save power.

advanced.reopen_launcher_about: The launcher opens again when the game closes.
advanced.no_launcher: The game started without the launcher: closing it opens nothing.
advanced.graphics_api_about: Automatic uses Vulkan, or DirectX 12 when Vulkan cannot start.
advanced.graphics_api_only: The one this computer's game uses.
advanced.looking_about: Looking for the computer's graphics cards.
advanced.performance_stats_about: Records frame times in the logs folder, from the next start.
advanced.api_validation_about: Checks every graphics call for errors and slows the game, from the next start.
advanced.log_detail_about: Which messages reach the console and the log, from the next start.
advanced.verbose_console_about: Also prints development traces and the game's own debug output.
advanced.log_window_about: Shows the log in a separate window.
advanced.launcher_note: The game images, the save folder and a full reset are in the launcher.
advanced.discord_status_about: Your Discord profile shows the menu or match you are in.

sound.game_levels_about: The game's own volume bars, which Recharged's levels above adjust further.
sound.reset_levels_about: Every sound level back to its default.

controls.rumble_about: The game's rumble on Wii Remotes and gamepads, like the Wii's own setting.
controls.rumble_strength_about: How strongly gamepads rumble. A Wii Remote's motor is only on or off.
controls.show_hud_about: Matches start with the scoreboard and markers shown. The HUD key still switches it.
controls.mouse_pointer_about: The mouse also points for a player 1 who plays alone, from the next start.
controls.sensor_bar_about: Where your sensor bar or DolphinBar sits, from the next start.
controls.ir_sensitivity_about: How readily the Remote sees the sensor bar (3 is the Wii's), from the next start.
controls.speaker: Speaker volume
controls.speaker_about: The Remotes' speakers. Turning them off or on counts from the next start.
controls.launcher_note: Players, pairing and the keys and buttons are set up in the launcher.

friends.title: FRIENDS
friends.no_recent: Nobody yet: the players you play a set against show here.

profile.title: MY PLAYER PROFILE
profile.no_stats: This server keeps no records yet.
profile.no_friends: No friends yet: add players from their page.

players.no_profile: Online needs a player profile: the launcher's Player profile page makes one.
players.in_match: You're in a match: challenges wait until it ends.
players.update_checking: Recharged is checking for updates: online play waits for the answer.
players.update_outdated: A newer version of Recharged is out: online play is off until you update. Close the game and start the launcher, which installs it.
players.update_unchecked: Recharged could not check for updates, so online play is off for now. Close the game and start the launcher to check again.
players.no_rules: This server has no rules to play sets by yet.
players.no_friends_online: None of your friends is online

you.no_profile: Make one on the launcher's Player profile page: then friends, challenges, sets and the leaderboards are here.

ranked.title: RANKED
ranked.waiting: On the way to RANKED: go back to the main menu or the online menu, the game goes on from there.

leaderboard.title: LEADERBOARD
leaderboard.no_profile: The leaderboards need a player profile: the launcher's Player profile page makes one.
leaderboard.missing: This server has no leaderboards yet.
leaderboard.nobody_today: Nobody has played RANKED today yet.

tournament.title: TOURNAMENT
tournament.sample: Sample data: no Recharged server is set (online.profile_server).
tournament.no_sets: This tournament has no sets yet: its bracket comes with at least two entrants.

server.failed: The Recharged server did not answer: {{error}}
server.stale: The Recharged server did not answer, this is its last answer: {{error}}
server.signed_out: Sign in to the Recharged server (the launcher's Online pages) to play tournaments.
server.discord_required: Tournaments are played with Discord: connect it in the launcher's Online pages (Connect Discord), then come back.
server.entries_open: Entries are open: {{count}} in so far.
server.joined: You are in: the bracket comes when the organizer starts it ({{count}} in so far).
server.entries_closed: Entries are closed: the bracket comes when the organizer starts it.
server.out: You are out of this tournament.
server.waiting_set: Your next set waits for the sets before it.
server.disputed: Your set's two reports disagree: the organizer decides.

tournaments.title: TOURNAMENTS
tournaments.best_of: Sets best of {{best_of}}, finals best of {{finals}}
tournaments.best_of_semifinals: Sets best of {{best_of}} (semifinals best of {{semifinals}}), finals best of {{finals}}
tournaments.none: No tournaments right now: an organizer opens them on the Recharged server.

bracket.title: BRACKET
bracket.pick: Point at a set that was played to see its games.

forfeit.title: FORFEIT
forfeit.match_note: The match ends for both of you and counts as a loss for you.
forfeit.set_note: The set ends for both of you: you lose it, whatever the score.
forfeit.tournament_note: You lose this game, whatever the score; the set goes on from the trophy room.

prompt.title: CHALLENGE
prompt.note: Accept, and your game goes straight to the set.
prompt.random_note: They searched for an opponent by these rules. Accept, and your game goes straight to the set.
prompt.your_pick: Your turn: you pick the stadium and draft first.
prompt.their_pick: {{name}} picked the stadium and drafts first.

set_end.rematch_asks_note: A rematch asks {{name}} to play the same set again.
set_end.rematch_your_pick: Rematch: your turn to pick the stadium and draft first.
set_end.rematch_their_pick: Rematch: {{name}}'s turn to pick the stadium and draft first.
set_end.play_again_note: Play it again is your Ready to play!: the set goes once {{name}} is ready too.
set_end.forfeited_reason: It counts as a loss for you.
set_end.opponent_forfeited_reason: {{name}} left the match and gave the set up.
set_end.gone_crying: {{name}} ran crying to the dressing room…
set_end.gone_home: {{name}} took the ball and went home…
set_end.gone_lineup: {{name}} saw your lineup and fled the pitch…
set_end.gone_kritters: {{name}} heard the Kritters were coming and ran…
set_end.failed_reason: A message in the game ended it.
set_end.not_ready_reason: {{name}} isn't ready any more, or your games didn't meet in time.
set_end.rematch_note: The same set again: {{name}} gets the challenge.
set_end.play_again_call_off_note: Play it again is your Ready to play!: the set goes once {{name}} is ready too. Not now calls it off.

sets.your_pick: Your turn: you pick the stadium and draft first.
sets.starting: Both are ready: the set starts
sets.play_ranked: Play RANKED in the game's online menu
sets.results_differ_about: The two games saw different results; nothing was counted.
sets.tournament_game_draw: Game {{game}} was a draw: it is played again
sets.tournament_set_goes_on: {{tournament}}: {{won}} - {{lost}} in the set. The next game starts from the trophy room.
sets.tournament_ready_in_room: {{tournament}}: press READY in the trophy room.
sets.tournament_opponent_ready: {{name}} is READY in the trophy room ({{tournament}}).

messages.opponent_forfeited: {{name}} forfeited the match: the win is yours
messages.tournament_set_ready: {{tournament}}: your set against {{name}} is ready. TOURNAMENT in the online menu, then READY
messages.set_waits: The set waits: go back to the main menu or the online menu, and the game takes you to RANKED
messages.set_replaced: Your other Recharged plays the set against {{name}}
messages.set_no_result: The set against {{name}} ended without a result
messages.server_no_answer: The server didn't answer. Try again on the launcher's Online pages.
messages.challenge_gone: The challenge is no longer open.
messages.rematch_gone: No rematch: the set is no longer there.
messages.rematch_no_answer: No answer from {{name}}: the rematch is called off
messages.rematch_called_off: The rematch with {{name}} is called off
messages.rematch_match_started: The rematch with {{name}} is called off: you started another match
messages.set_gone: The set is no longer open.
messages.ranked_waits: RANKED waits: go back to the main menu or the online menu, and the game takes you there
messages.wider_view: Wider view: more of the stadium in matches
messages.stretched: Picture stretched to fill the window
messages.replay_differs: This replay no longer matches its recording.
messages.watch_turbo_eta: Catching up: {{behind}} behind, live in about {{seconds}} s
messages.watch_catch_up_title: Catching up with the live match
messages.watch_catch_up_eta: {{played}} of {{live}} played, live in about {{seconds}} s
messages.watch_waiting: Game over: waiting for the match's next game
messages.watch_next_game: The next game begins: following the match

notices.rules_not_saved: Your challenges' rules were not saved: {{error}}
